issues: The workbench guessed 104f from source, cutting exactly on the brake: the Today card, the 1.28x push and the hold were never seen
A debug title 'TIMELINE TRAVEL' sits on top, cards are grey skeletons and tick labels fall back to Helvetica
Each interpolate segment carried its own inOut easing, so velocity dropped to zero at every breakpoint and the travel stuttered
A light grey stage with a single axis line: no foreground or background, so all speed had to come from the cards
changes: Ember warm-black stage: a glowing axis on a horizon light band, minor ticks every 140px as speed references, 380px gradient years in the background at 0.35x parallax and defocused bokeh in front at 1.6x

The camera follows one continuous velocity profile (smoothstep start, cruise, quadratic brake over the last 18%) integrated into a position table, with no stutter; horizontal motion blur during the sprint
Milestone cards rebuilt as 620x300 publish-grade cards (version chip, date, 54px title, line, metric) that spring up from the axis 6f before visual arrival as stems grow and nodes light
After the brake a 14f snappy push to 1.28 lands on 'Today · Ferro Agents' with accent stroke, glow and a brighter horizon; the header exits so the end frame has one hero
Duration fixed at an exported 160f with a 42f hold after the brake, creeping 1.28 to 1.30
